changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' as this is not the primary task - the paper generates clinical reasoning, not summaries. Consolidated duplicate output descriptions. Normalized model names with consistent hyphenation.

Removed all metrics because they are used to evaluate health risk prediction (classification tasks), not the generated clinical reasoning text. The paper does not use automatic NLG evaluation metrics.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators of generated outputs. LLMs are used for generation only.
No human evaluation of the generated clinical reasoning text is conducted in the paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on health risk prediction using EHR data enhanced with LLM-generated clinical reasoning. While it generates natural language (clinical reasoning text), the primary evaluation is on classification performance (health risk prediction), not on the quality of the generated text itself. No NLG-specific evaluation (automatic metrics, human evaluation, or LLM-as-judge) is performed.
